title: retire playground.pollinations.ai: redirect to pollinations.ai/play, remove the app
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The playground has moved into the main website at pollinations.ai/play. The website Worker adds a 301 redirect from every playground.pollinations.ai URL to /play, and the standalone apps/playground app is removed. The React example's “Try it out in Playground” link now points to /play; the old app is also removed from the App catalog and model-compatibility test configuration. The playground column in weekly_official_app_usage remains for historical KPI data.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden, Polli wears a tiny guide hat and points from an old playground sign toward a welcoming /play doorway framed by code-plants and a prominent lime green (#ecf874) glow. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, never oversized, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
